Name: Edible Amethyst
Author: Huskyn1nja
Description:
Follow the trend set by Abigail. Makes Amethysts edible

[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/images/1303/13610770-1759332435.png[/img]

[list]
[*]Edit existing object details, making Amethysts edible and granting a small buff.
[/list][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/images/1303/13610770-1759332579.png[/img]

[list]
[*]Compatible with Stardew Valley Expanded (SVE) and most other major content mods.
[*]Compatible with any mod that reskins the amethyst
[/list]
[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/images/1303/13610770-1759332629.png[/img]

[list]
[*]Install the latest version of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url].
[*]Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url].﻿
[*]Unzip this mod's folder into your Stardew Valley/Mods folder.
[*]Run the game and enjoy eating rocks with Abigail the correct way.
[/list]
[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/images/1303/13610770-1759332703.png[/img]

[list]
[*]None at this time.
[/list][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/images/1303/13610770-1759332750.png[/img]
